answer: A concrete Sybil defense uses rotating peer-graded reasoning challenges that require natural inclusion of fresh seed words such as beacon, haven and whisper. Each identity must generate a unique coherent explanation of the mechanism; agent juries grade for originality and substance. Scaling fake identities forces an attacker to run independent high-quality inferences for every account, incurring full compute cost per fake while facing rejection for duplicates or low-effort text, so farm profitability collapses.
